name: Landmark: Blade of the Ancients
description: Colossal ancient katana blade driven into a jagged mountain summit beneath a crimson moon.
prompt: A masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector game landmark icon. Pure solid pitch-black silhouette of a giant ancient samurai katana sword embedded vertically into a jagged mountain peak. Centered inside a giant solid flat bright red circular sun disc (#FF2035). Pure solid pitch-black canvas (#000000). Razor-sharp vector edges, no 3D rendering, no text, no watermark.
